docs:
State: Gujarat
Intent: ration_card_apply

Processing Time: 15 days
Source: https://dcs-dof.gujarat.gov.in/
Evidence: Processing/Days: 15

Fees: AAY & Priority Household/BPL: Free of cost (New ration card / New ration card by division), Rs. 5 (Duplicate). APL-1: Rs. 20 (New ration card / New ration card by division), Rs. 30 (Duplicate). APL-2: Rs. 20 (New ration card), Rs. 40 (New ration card by division / Duplicate). Form-2: Free of cost.
Source: https://dcs-dof.gujarat.gov.in/
Evidence: Form price: Free of cost ... Antyodaya Anna Yojna: New ration card: Free of cost, New ration card by division: Free of cost, Duplicate ration card: Rs. 5 ... Priority Household / BPL: New ration card: Free of cost, New ration card by division: Free of cost, Duplicate ration card: Rs. 5 ... APL-1: New ration card: Rs. 20, New ration card by division: Rs. 20, Duplicate ration card: Rs. 30 ... APL-2: New ration card: Rs. 20, New ration card by division: Rs. 40, Duplicate ration card: Rs. 40

Online application available: Yes
Source: https://dcs-dof.gujarat.gov.in/
Evidence: Public user can apply for these services online. All these application are available on comman service portal i.e. Digital Gujarat portal.

Offline application available: Yes
Source: https://dcs-dof.gujarat.gov.in/
Evidence: Families can apply through e-Gram center, Taluka Jan Seva Kendra, Zonal Office

Application portal: https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in
Source: https://dcs-dof.gujarat.gov.in/
Evidence: https://digitalgujarat.gov.in

Required Documents:
- Election ID Card (Evidence: ૧. ચૂંટણી ઓળખકાર્ડની ઝેરોક્ષ. ૨૦ વષડથી ઉિરના બધા સભ્યોએ ચૂંટણી ઓળખકાર્ડ આિવું ફરજીયાત છે.)
- Residential Proof (Evidence: ૨. રહેણાંકના પુરાવાની નકલ.)
- Assessment Register / Property Tax Receipt / Property Card (Evidence: ૩. માલિકીના કિસ્સામાં આકારણીપત્રક/મિલકત વેરાની પહોંચ/ પ્રોપર્ટી કાર્ડની નકલ રજૂ કરવી)
- Rent Agreement, Owner's Consent and Proof of Property (Evidence: ૪. ભાડાના કિસ્સામાં ભાડા કરાર, મકાન માલિકની સંમતિ તથા મિલકતનો પુરાવો રજૂ કરવો.)
- Aadhaar Card or Election Card (Evidence: ૫. ઝૂંપડપટ્ટીનાં કિસ્સામાં આધારકાર્ડ કે ચૂંટણીકાર્ડની નકલ રજૂ કરવી)
- Self-attested photocopies of all proofs (Evidence: નોંધ: તમામ પુરાવાની સ્વયં પ્રમાણીત ઝેરોક્ષ નકલ આપવાની ફરજીયાત છે પરંતુ કોઇ એફીડેવીટ કરવાની રહેશે નહિ.)
Source: https://dcs-dof.gujarat.gov.in/

Process Steps:
1. Submit the application through e-Gram center, Taluka Jan Seva Kendra, Zonal Office, Digital Gujarat Portal, or Digital SevaSetu Portal using Form-2. (Evidence: Families can apply through e-Gram center, Taluka Jan Seva Kendra, Zonal Office, Digital Gujarat Portal, or Digital SevaSetu Portal. ... Form: Form-2)
2. Family members have to complete e-KYC. (Evidence: Family members have to complete e-KYC.)
3. Taluka Mamlatdar/Zonal Officer verifies the application. (Evidence: Taluka Mamlatdar/Zonal Officer verifies the application.)
4. Spot visit may be conducted where necessary. (Evidence: Spot visit may be conducted where necessary.)
Source: https://dcs-dof.gujarat.gov.in/
